title: 第52章 他是本宫的人，谁敢动？
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 见到这一幕，众人知道事情大了。唐逸的狂妄，终归要将自己玩死了。“唐逸，你放肆！谁给你的胆子冒犯太子的？”唐画站了出来，满脸的恨铁不成钢：“还不快跪下给殿下赎罪，你想害死我唐家吗？”“今日好好的庆功宴，都被你搅黄了，你还要连累父亲和你一样身败名裂吗？”唐画站在道德制高点，以好哥哥的形象，指责呵斥唐逸。如此，方能挽回一点丢失的颜面。闻言，唐逸却是摇了摇头，道：“唐画，面具戴久了，别以为就会成真的了。唐敬会身败名裂，这是肯定的，但不是因为我，而是你。”“我今日不揭穿你，不是我没这个实力，而是有些事让别人来说，比我开口更有说服力。”不急，沈园诗会，老王爷赶得上。偷窃老王爷的专属BGM，到时候你自己和他老人家解释去。唐画瞳孔陡缩，心头顿时一阵心虚。别人来说？谁？这废物难道还有后手？但，那又如何？我是陛下钦点的新科状元，就算那小诗仙出面指认，能证明得了我抄袭？想到这些，唐画带笑容道：“唐逸，少在这里装神弄鬼，想说什么你直接说出来……父亲和太子殿下都在这里，他们可以给你做主。”唐敬更是气到发抖，大声怒斥：“放肆，混账东西，殴打兄长嫂嫂，你现在还想攀咬大哥吗？”虽然不知道唐逸打的什么哑谜，但他清楚这混账的哑谜肯定是不怀好意。他是真想将唐家给毁了啊！唐逸看了一眼唐敬，果然这老头对唐画太信任，已经到了不允许任何质疑的地步。就是不知道真相被赤裸裸揭开的时候，唐敬能不能扛得住，这个时代可没有什么速效救心丸。要是被气死了……呃，和我有关系吗？“唐侍郎，唐状元，既然他不领情，你们又何必自讨没趣。”太子笑着看向唐逸，淡淡道：“此事，还是交给孤处理吧，唐逸当着孤的面伤人，这是挑衅大炎律法，大炎律法不容侵犯。”“来人，立即将唐逸拿下！押送京兆府等候发落。”太子卫立即向唐逸围上来。“殿下！”唐敬想说什么，但手被唐画拉住，冲着他轻微摇了摇头。唐敬看了唐逸一眼，只得闭上了双眼。罢了，是这混账自己找死。不能因为他而害了整个唐家。且先让他去牢里吃点苦头，等太子气消了，再想办法捞他出来吧。如今，只能这样了。然而，下一秒唐敬差点被吓死，因为唐逸竟然又抓起了一把椅子。这混账东西竟然还想反抗！“逆子，逆子，逆子……”唐敬顿时指着唐逸，气得说不出话来。而唐画，颜霜玉，林竹都激动起来。对，就是这样，去反抗吧！敢反抗，他就死定了。见到唐逸抓起椅子，太子眸色一冷，道：“敢负隅顽抗，杀无赦！”一个废物，一而再再而三地挑战他的底线，该死！唐逸抬头，轻笑一声：“刚好，我这个人也不喜欢束手就擒，不过，殿下最好想清楚，今日动了手，我们就是敌人了。”是敌人，那我就不能让你坐上那个位置，否则对我来说太危险了。是敌人，今日我若不死，你这太子的位置，坐不了太久了。闻言，太子怒极反笑。敌人？孤很怕和你成为敌人吗？他冷漠挥手：“动手！”眼看大战一触即发，离得近的人，都下意识向后躲开，免得波及。此时，很多人看向唐逸的目光，犹如在看一个白痴。面对太子卫几十人，分分钟能将你剁成肉泥，你还敢狂？“谁敢动本宫的人！”就在这时，一道轻喝声传来。唐逸抬头，就看到两位身材高挑的大美女，正从外面走进来。正是孔诗岚和公主萧澜。见到萧澜，唐逸脸色不由僵了下……还好，这个女人没有说谁敢动本宫孩子他爹！不然，事情就大条了。“呃，是高阳公主。”“难怪这家伙敢这么狂妄，原来是傍上了高阳公主。”“还有孔家小姐？不会吧？孔家小姐和他也有关系？”“……”整个天香楼顿时喧嚣起来，所有人议论纷纷，震惊不已。这让颜霜玉气得一张脸都扭曲了，又惊又怒，她辛辛苦苦为儿子密谋，就是想要给儿子说一门好亲事。结果她辛辛苦苦没做到的事，唐逸这贱种竟然轻而易举做到了。凭什么？他也配？唐画瞳孔骤缩，手下意识攥成拳。孔诗岚是他看上的女人，难道这女人也要帮唐逸出头吗？唐敬也很是诧异，这废物儿子竟然能和公主攀上关系？太子见到萧澜，嘴角带着笑容，眸中却带着冷意：“澜儿，不许胡说，一个未出阁的姑娘，什么你的人？”萧澜是贤妃之女，贤妃和他母亲皇后是死对头，他对萧澜自然没有半点好感。甚至，对于这个深受父皇宠爱的公主，他恨其不死。“他就是本宫的人，本宫说是，他就是。”“太子哥哥要是有意见，那就憋着。”萧澜将唐逸拉到身后，那是本宫孩子的爹，怎么就不是本宫的人了？孔诗岚看了一眼满地狼藉的天香楼大厅，眉心下意识挑了挑。这是唐逸这家伙干的？这家伙还真是闲不住啊！“他当着孤的面伤人，这里所有人都是人证，你要袒护他？”太子脸色难看下来，憋着，连你也敢忤逆孤？萧澜扭头看向唐逸，挤眉弄眼：“啊？有这事？”这没什么可否认的，唐逸点头，道：“有这事。”萧澜咬牙，加重语气：“说没有。”唐逸：“……”美女，你这是硬护短啊！再说我是男人，敢作敢为，哪里都不能短。“有这事，他们伤了我妹妹。”唐逸没有隐瞒，虽然公主是好意，但他不能不懂事是吧。萧澜抬头，美眸闪闪：“皇兄，你听到了？是他们有错在先。”“那唐逸收拾他们有问题吗？没问题吧！”“要是我被人打了，太子哥哥还要和人讲理吗？”太子愤怒得嘴角微颤，你要是被打了，我不会讲理，我会畅饮三百杯。
content_en: Seeing this scene, everyone knew that something was serious.Tang Yi's arrogance will eventually kill him."Tang Yi, you are so presumptuous! Who gave you the courage to offend the crown prince?" Tang Hua stood up, with a face full of hatred: "Why don't you kneel down and atone for His Highness, do you want to kill my Tang family?" "Today's wonderful celebration banquet has been ruined by you, do you want to bring your father into ruin like you?" Tang Hua stood on the moral high ground, and used the image of a good brother to accuse and scold Tang Yi.Only in this way can we save some lost face.Hearing this, Tang Yi shook his head and said: "Tang Hua, if you wear the mask for a long time, don't think it will come true. Tang Jinghui will be ruined, that's for sure, but not because of me, but because of you." "I won't expose you today, not because I don't have the strength, but because there are some things that others can say more convincingly than me." No hurry, Shen Yuan Poetry Club, the old prince can catch up.Stealing the old prince's exclusive BGM, you can explain it to him when the time comes.Tang Hua's pupils shrank sharply, and he suddenly felt guilty.For others?who?Does this trash have a back-up plan?But, so what?I am the number one scholar in the new subject appointed by His Majesty. Even if the little poetry fairy comes forward to accuse me, can he prove that I plagiarized?Thinking of this, Tang Hua said with a smile: "Tang Yi, stop pretending here, just say what you want to say... Father and His Royal Highness are here, they can make the decision for you." Tang Jing was so angry that he trembled and shouted angrily: "You wanton, you bastard, you beat your brother and sister-in-law, do you still want to bite me now?" Although he didn't know what kind of riddle Tang Yi was playing, he knew that this bastard's riddle must have bad intentions.He really wanted to destroy the Tang family!Tang Yi glanced at Tang Jing. Sure enough, the old man trusted Tang Hua so much that he didn't allow any questions.I just don't know if Tang Jing can handle it when the truth is revealed. There are no quick-acting pills in this era.If you are so angry...well, does it have anything to do with me?"Tang Shilang, Tang Zhuangyuan, since he doesn't appreciate it, why are you asking for trouble." The prince smiled and looked at Tang Yi and said calmly: "Let's leave this matter to Gu. Tang Yi hurt someone in front of Gu. This is provoking the laws of Dayan. The laws of Dayan are inviolable." "Come here, capture Tang Yi immediately! Escort him to Jingzhao Mansion to wait for punishment." The prince's guard immediately surrounded Tang Yi."Your Highness!" Tang Jing wanted to say something, but his hand was held by Tang Hua, who slightly shook his head at him.Tang Jing glanced at Tang Yi and had to close his eyes.That's all, this bastard is looking for death.The entire Tang family cannot be harmed because of him.Let him go to jail to suffer some hardships first, and then find a way to get him out after the prince's anger subsides.Now, that's all.However, Tang Jing was almost frightened to death in the next second, because Tang Yi actually grabbed another chair.This bastard actually wants to resist!"You are a traitor, you are a traitor, you are a traitor..." Tang Jing immediately pointed at Tang Yi and was so angry that he couldn't speak.Tang Hua, Yan Shuangyu and Lin Zhu all became excited.Yes, that’s it, go and resist!If he dares to resist, he will be dead.Seeing Tang Yi grab the chair, the prince's eyes turned cold and he said: "If you dare to resist, you will be killed without mercy!" Damn it for a loser who challenges his bottom line again and again!Tang Yi raised his head and chuckled: "It just so happens that I don't like to be caught without mercy, but Your Highness had better think clearly. If you take action today, we will become enemies." If you are an enemy, then I can't let you sit in that position, otherwise it will be too dangerous for me.You are an enemy. If I don't die today, you won't be able to hold the position of prince for much longer.Hearing this, the prince was so angry that he laughed instead.enemy?Are you afraid of becoming your enemy?He waved coldly: "Do it!" Seeing that the war was about to break out, those who were close subconsciously moved back to avoid being affected.At this time, many people looked at Tang Yi as if they were looking at an idiot.Facing dozens of people from the Crown Prince's Guard who can chop you into pieces in a matter of minutes, how dare you still be so crazy?"Who dares to touch the people of this palace!" At this moment, a soft drink came.Tang Yi looked up and saw two tall beauties walking in from outside.It is Kong Shilan and Princess Xiao Lan.Seeing Xiao Lan, Tang Yi couldn't help but froze... Fortunately, this woman didn't say who dared to touch the father of my child!Otherwise, things will get serious."Uh, it's Princess Gaoyang." "No wonder this guy dares to be so arrogant. It turns out he's in love with Princess Gaoyang." "And Miss Kong? No way? Miss Kong is also related to him?" "..." The entire Tianxiang Tower suddenly became noisy, and everyone was talking and shocked.This made Yan Shuangyu so angry that her face was distorted, she was shocked and angry. She worked hard to plot for her son, just because she wanted to find a good marriage for her son.As a result, Tang Yi, a bitch, did what she had worked so hard not to do with ease.Why?Is he worthy?Tang Hua's pupils shrank suddenly and his hands subconsciously clenched into fists.Kong Shilan is the woman he likes. Does this woman also want to help Tang Yi stand out?Tang Jing was also very surprised. This good-for-nothing son could actually have a relationship with the princess?When the prince saw Xiao Lan, there was a smile on his lips, but there was a coldness in his eyes: "Lan'er, don't talk nonsense, a girl who has not left the court, who is your person?" Xiao Lan is the daughter of Concubine Xian, Concubine Xian and his mother, the Queen, are mortal enemies, so he naturally has no good impression of Xiao Lan.He even hated this princess who was deeply loved by his father."He is from me. If I say so, he is." "Brother Prince, if you have any objections, just keep it to yourself." Xiao Lan pulled Tang Yi behind him. He was the father of my child. Why is he not from me?Kong Shilan glanced at the messy Tianxiang Tower hall, and raised her eyebrows subconsciously.This guy Tang Yi did this?This guy really can’t sit still!"He hurt someone in front of Gu. Everyone here is a witness. Do you want to protect him?" The prince's face turned ugly and he was holding back. How dare you disobey Ni Gu?Xiao Lan turned to look at Tang Yi and winked: "Huh? Is this the case?" There is nothing to deny. Tang Yi nodded and said: "It is the case." Xiao Lan gritted his teeth and emphasized his tone: "Say no." Tang Yi: "..." Beauty, you are trying to protect yourself!Besides, I am a man, I dare to act boldly, and I cannot be short on anything."They hurt my sister because of this." Tang Yi didn't hide it. Although the princess had good intentions, he couldn't be ignorant, right?Xiao Lan raised his head, his beautiful eyes sparkling: "Brother Emperor, did you hear that? They were at fault first." "Then Tang Yi will deal with him.
title_en: Chapter 52 He is from this palace, who dares to touch him?
